review_candidates.title: Head of Partner Support
review_candidates.description: Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region. Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA. Position Summary The Head of Partner Support owns how Property Finder supports its partners across the region. You’ll lead the frontline, back office and Tech Operations teams, run a disciplined, high-performing operation every day, and make sure partners get fast, accurate and effortless support, delivered in a way that exceeds their expectations. At the same time, you’ll transform Partner Support into an AI-powered operation that combines intelligent automation, expert people and strong knowledge. You’ll turn every partner contact into a source of insight that helps us improve our products and retain our partners. Key Responsibilities Run The Operations Build and execute the Partner Support plan and operating model, balancing AI-powered operations with human expertise, keeping people in charge of complex issues and building partner relationships that drive retention. Own end-to-end operational performance across frontline, back office and Technical Operations, in every market and channel. Own forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling and real-time management, optimising service level, occupancy and schedule adherence. Build the performance management system, including KPIs, dashboards, benchmarking and executive reporting. Drive SLA, first-contact resolution, resolution time, automated resolution, CSAT, quality, productivity and cost-per-resolution. Run the operational cadence: daily huddles, weekly operations reviews, monthly business reviews and real-time management standards. Own workflows, SOPs and controls, and ensure operational readiness for every product launch and campaign. Own quality results with the Quality team, turning QA insights into coaching and performance improvements. Own incident management end to end, leading Tech Operations to triage complex platform issues, coordinate fixes with Engineering and keep partners informed until resolution. Act as the senior escalation point for critical and reputation-sensitive issues. Hire, lead and develop Team Leaders through clear standards, playbooks, peer calibration and succession planning, and build a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. Present performance, insights and business cases to senior leadership. Elevate the partner experience Define and embed the Partner Support service standard and tone of voice across every channel, in English and Arabic, with differentiated support models by partner segment. Shift the team from reactive to proactive support, and from resolving issues to exceeding partner expectations, through personal and empathetic service. Transform the operation Drive automated resolution, deflection and seamless AI-to-human handoffs across chat, email, voice, WhatsApp and self-service. Increase partner adoption of self-service and digital channels, reducing reliance on manual support. Own the technology and AI roadmap, with clear pilots, success measures and scaling criteria. Establish AI quality, risk and governance frameworks, including response standards and hallucination mitigation. Build feedback loops that turn resolution failures and escalation patterns into improvements to AI, workflows and knowledge. Evolve from volume-based to complexity-based, specialist-led resolution, with competency frameworks and career paths for an AI-augmented workforce. Use predictive analytics and Voice of the Partner to identify emerging issues and partner risks, quantify their business impact and find opportunities for proactive resolution. Partner with Product and Engineering to remove root causes and inform AI and product roadmap priorities. Partner with Commercial and Customer Success to connect support performance to partner satisfaction, retention and growth. Desired Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management or a related field. 10+ years in Customer Support or Customer Operations, including 5+ years leading managers or team leaders, ideally in B2B tech, SaaS or marketplace businesses. Proven track record of running and improving multi-channel support operations to SLA, quality and cost targets. Strong workforce management expertise: forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling and budgeting. Proven experience transforming support with AI at scale: automated resolution, AI-to-human handoffs, AI quality governance and knowledge operations, with measurable results. Highly analytical, with strong stakeholder management and presentation skills at senior level. Proficient with CRM, ticketing and productivity tools; Salesforce and Zendesk preferred. Fluent English and Arabic speaker Real estate knowledge is an advantage Other Capabilities Bias for impact: Focuses on measurable outcomes rather than activity and is comfortable challenging processes that do not create value. Customer obsessed: Understands the operational realities of our Real Estate partners and advocates for solutions that genuinely make it easier for them to do business with Property Finder. Technology curious: Actively experiments with AI and emerging technologies rather than waiting for solutions to be provided. Commercially minded: Understands the relationship between support quality, partner satisfaction, retention, revenue and cost-to-serve. Data driven: Uses evidence to identify problems, prioritise opportunities and measure success. Systems thinker: Looks beyond individual tickets to identify patterns, root causes and opportunities to permanently remove friction. Builder mentality: Comfortable designing new processes, operating models and capabilities rather than simply managing existing ones. Cross-functional influencer: Able to turn Partner Support insight into action across Product, Engineering, Commercial and Customer Experience. High ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes end-to-end and operates effectively in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. Our promise to talent At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.
